about.description: Natural gas perpetual market. The contract tracks Henry Hub natural-gas pricing, the main U.S. benchmark for gas markets. Users get linear commodity price exposure only, without owning physical gas, storage claims, or a deliverable futures position. Pricing uses a futures-based external reference with scheduled contract rolls. Positions are margined and cash-settled in USDC. Markets are visible on Hyperliquid under the xyz namespace, but are operated by trade[XYZ] rather than listed as core Hyperliquid perps.
